messages:
maya: quick heads-up — i'm drafting the v2 deprecation / roll-forward plan and want to lock owners and cross-team gates. timeline proposal: staged deprecations start 2026-04-08, full sunset 2026-07-01.
ash: ack, pinged SDK owners. ashwin will drive the node/python sdk compat checks.
ash: (actually me) ashwin: you ok to own SDK rollout + migration guide?
ash: @ashwin?
ash: :slightly_smiling_face:
ash: sorry, typo — i meant to @ashwin-original — ignore
ash: (putting this in thread for clarity)
ash: the runtime team needs to confirm old-v2 fallback performance for burst workloads.
ash: sloane, are we green on fallback perf?
sloane: we ran the 99th percentile perf tests yesterday. fallback adds ~45ms median, 90-95ms p99 on worst-case long sequences. details in the perf doc: https://go.redwood/perf/v2-fallback (internal).
maya: thanks. that's within our SLO margin for now but we should gate canary traffic. plan: canary 1% for 48h, 10% for 72h, then 100% after signoff.
ben: who signs off for security/compat? we need SSO token auth checks for legacy clients.
maya: lina owns auth gating. lina: can you confirm token exchange backward compat and any hotfix window requirements?
lina: yep — auth teams ran token exchange tests. two legacy clients require header fallback (X-Old-Auth). PR #2467 implements header shim. Will need a docs blurb and a short migration note. ETA for PR review: 2026-03-29.
nash: noted. ashwin — SDKs need a quick toggle to fallback to old endpoints if 4xx spikes. can we ship a runtime toggle + SDK flag?
nash: ashwin pls confirm
ash: :eyes:
ash: also need a canary monitor playbook (who paginates on errors)
ash: propose oncall: eng-runtime primary, eng-sre secondary for first 72h
ash: thoughts?
ash: @deploy-bot will create canary channel if we confirm
ash: (i'll stop spamming, this is the plan)
ash: ops note: ensure throttling rules exclude internal health checks to avoid feedback loops.
ash: cc: release manager for release notes
ash: ok back to thread owners
ash: ashwin?
ash: 
ashwin: can take SDK ownership. timeline: embed compat tests into CI, add flag (--use-v2-fallback) to SDKs, and ship minor patch for node/python by 2026-04-01. PRs will reference #sdk-v2-migrate.
nash: great. still need runtime toggle from sloane.
sloane: will add runtime toggle + rollout pipeline. gating checklist:
- runtime toggle implemented (sloane)
- SDK flag + CI tests (ashwin)
- auth shim PR merged (lina)
- docs migration note (maya + devex)
- canary monitors + runbook (ben + eng-sre)

sloane: timeline wise i can have toggle and pipeline by 2026-03-31. will add automated fallback metrics (errors, latency, token-level drop).

lina: i’ll merge the auth shim PR by 3/29 and follow up with the docs snippet in rfc/migrations.

maya: devex will draft migration note and quickstart scripts. sample curl we will recommend in docs:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd/llama-v2","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate
```
maya: devex to send first pass by 3/30.

ben: i’ll coordinate with eng-sre on monitors and escalate thresholds. proposed alerts: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained 5m, p99 latency > 300ms on fallback route.

deploy-bot: canary channel created: #canary-v2-1832106543. Auto-ops enabled for 48h at 1% traffic.

maya: perfect. last open question: migration owners for partners (mobile sdk and partner-proxy). ashwin/ben — can you two reach out to partner engs and verify they can flip flags?

ashwin: will coordinate with mobile team today.

ben: partner-proxy has a scheduled maintenance window on 2026-04-05, might block 4/5-4/6. we should avoid canary step during that window or delay by 48h.

maya: thanks — moving the canary start from 4/08 to 4/10 to avoid overlap. update the timeline doc.

lina: added note and updated PR timeline.

maya: thanks team. action items summary in thread: owners (sdk=ashwin, runtime=sloane, auth=lina, docs=maya/devex, monitors=ben/eng-sre). blockers: partner maintenance window (ben). next check-in: async updates here by end of week or call Fri 09:30 PT.

ashwin: ack.

sloane: ack.

lina: ack.

ben: ack.

maya: closing thread for now — will reopen if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
